rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a geographic region or district, including an EU region when administrative precision is not being stressed.

example.english: This region has had many more tourists lately.
example.traditional: 呢個地區近排多咗好多遊客。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 dei6 keoi1 gan6 paai4 do1 zo2 hou2 do1 jau4 haak3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a part or area of the body.

example.english: This region of my body still hurts a bit.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 bou6 wai6 zung6 jau5 di1 tung3

rows.note: Choose this instead of the broader 地區 when the region is explicitly an official administrative subdivision.

example.english: This administrative region will raise taxes this year.
example.traditional: 呢個行政區今年會加稅。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hang4 zing3 keoi1 gam1 nin4 wui5 gaa1 seoi3

rows.note: Use this for an approximate range or span rather than a geographic territory.

example.english: The price is roughly in the region of three hundred to five hundred dollars.
example.traditional: 個價錢大概喺三百蚊到五百蚊嘅範圍。
example.jyutping: go3 gaa3 cin2 daai6 koi3 hai2 saam1 baak3 man1 dou3 ng5 baak3 man1 ge3 faan6 wai4
